permissionHelp.keysNote: Used on the server to run the size query, then dropped. Never sent to this Mac or to the AI.
permissionHelp.whyTitle: Why we don’t ask for sudo
permissionHelp.whyText: A monitoring app with root is one more thing that can go wrong. Daminus reads as your normal user and tells you exactly which permission is missing, so you decide.

miner.label: Miner check, partial coverage · sec.miner on {host}
miner.title: Checked {seen} of {total} processes
miner.text: {user} can see its own {seen} processes. The other {rest} belong to other users, and where they run from can only be read as root. A miner running as www-data would not be seen, so this is never “none”.
miner.rootTitle: A · Scan this host as root
miner.rootText: Add a second Host block that logs in as root and use it for this project. Daminus stays read-only.
miner.hidepidTitle: B · Relax hidepid or ptrace limits
miner.hidepidText: If /proc is mounted with hidepid, other processes are not even counted. Allowing them only raises the count; their paths still need root or ptrace rights.
